{{< include _setup.qmd >}}

```{r}
#| label: Generate output
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

cat(
  # The funding statement wraps beside the EU emblem the inner footer holds:
  # the whole block is indented past the emblem, so where a line breaks is the
  # layout's decision rather than the translation's. It is the certificate's
  # own string rather than the glossary's term of the same text, because a
  # language's glossary reaches the reports only once that whole catalogue is
  # 80 % translated, and the certificate's translations would otherwise wait
  # on it.
  paste0(
    "\\cfoot*{\\parbox[b]{\\linewidth}{\\raggedright\\leftskip=1.5cm\\relax ",
    sR$content[1],
    "}}"),
  "\\selectlanguage{british}",
  "",
  "\\begin{center}",
  "\\vspace*{-1.25\\baselineskip}",
  "",
  paste(
  if (data$startYear == data$endYear) {sR$content[2]} else {sR$content[3]},
  "\\vspace*{1.25\\baselineskip}",
  paste0(
    "\\Huge \\bfseries ",
    if (data$startYear == data$endYear) {
      data$startYear
    } else {
      paste0(data$startYear, "-", data$endYear)
    },
    "\\normalsize \\normalfont"
  ),
  "\\vspace*{1.25\\baselineskip}",
  interpolate_translation(
    sR$content[4],
    hospital = paste(
      "\\vspace*{1.25\\baselineskip}",
      paste0(
        "\\large \\bfseries ",
        data$hospitalName,
        "\\normalsize \\normalfont"
      ),
      "\\vspace*{1.25\\baselineskip}",
      sep = "\n\n")
    ),
  sep = "\n\n"
  ),
  "",
  "\\end{center}",
  "",
  "\\vspace*{1.25\\baselineskip}",
  "",
  interpolate_translation(
    sR$content[5],
    patient_count = paste0('**', format(data$nPatients), '**')
  ),
  "",
  paste0("\\vspace*{", sR$signature_offset, "\\baselineskip}"),
  "\\begin{textblock*}{10cm}(12cm,26cm)",
  paste0(data$signatory,"\\\\"),
  paste0(sR$content[6],"\\\\"),
  "\\end{textblock*}",
  "\\begin{textblock*}{10cm}(2.5cm,26cm)",
  paste(sR$content[7], format(Sys.Date(), format = "%x")),
  "\\end{textblock*}",
  # A double quote in the alt text would close `fig-alt="` early and make Pandoc
  # abandon the whole attribute block — losing fig-align as well as the alt, and
  # emitting the braces as literal text. Not reachable from the English source,
  # but a translator writing a quoted term would hit it silently, so drop them.
  paste0(
    "![](", data$signatureImagePath,
    '){fig-align="right" fig-alt="',
    gsub('"', "", sR$signature_alt, fixed = TRUE), '"}'),
  sep = "\n"
)
```
